62c2ad292705cf6714a93f82625fed4a5fa340f5.summary: A FireEye blog post (June 12, 2017) analysing the CARBANAK backdoor: a data-stealing backdoor with a plugin architecture, 34 commands, and pseudo-HTTP and custom binary C2 protocols that changed across versions. The report reviews 220 samples. It attributes CARBANAK activity in its Mandiant investigations to FIN7, active against US restaurant and hospitality since mid-2015, and describes a wider Carbanak Group label, bank targeting in the US, Middle East and Asia, and earlier 2014-2015 reporting. Several links are hedged.
